title: Constant realization preserves flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: On any small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], for a commutative coefficient ring R, if an unbounded complex P of R-modules is K-flat and termwise flat, the termwise actual constant realization c_R(P) [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor] is K-flat over the constant ring sheaf [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Universes of site objects and morphisms may differ; coefficients and sections lie in their maximum universe.

source.place: Tag 0G7E, constant-realization specialization proved without constructing a morphism to the point site.

proof.text: Constant module presheaves preserve colimits by evaluation, and module sheafification is a left adjoint. Thus constant realization preserves integer-indexed colimits. It preserves flat objects by the local relation proof.

Install the closed monoidal Grothendieck structures and ordinary-module functorial flat resolution. Apply flat-term K-flat preservation. For any acyclic Z apply the categorical K-flat condition to the quasi-isomorphism 0→Z to show Z⊗c_R(P) acyclic.
